start: A gym member in a live workout with Barbell Bench Press: 3 sets filled and ticked

user_sees: The finish sheet with a name, a note box and the end time
must_not: The workout saved before the member confirms on the sheet

user_sees: The finish summary screen of the saved workout
must_not: Two saved workouts from a fast double tap
Warm-up sets counted as working sets

user_sees: Bench Press with the 3 sets as logged, the exercise note on it

start: A gym member whose workout has Bench Press on two cards: heavy 3 x 5, then back-off 2 x 10 with its own note

steps.action: Tick all sets, tap 'Finish workout', confirm
must_not: The two cards merged into one Bench Press with sets 1-5

user_sees: Two Bench Press cards in their places, each with its own sets and note
must_not: The second card's note or superset hidden
The cards in a different order

start: A gym member editing a saved workout from History

steps.action: Open the workout, tap edit, untick one saved set, add one new set without ticking it, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: The workout saved without the unticked set and with the new set
must_not: The unticked saved set still saved
An assisted set's help saved as a positive weight

start: A gym member with 3 filled Bench Press rows, 2 ticked and 1 never ticked

user_sees: Choice 'Leave them out' (selected) / 'Save them' for the unticked row
must_not: The unticked row saved without asking

start: A gym member with no set ticked, or only warm-up sets

user_sees: 'Nothing to save' and 'Tick at least one set before finishing.'
must_not: An empty or warm-up-only workout saved that then vanishes from History

start: A gym member in a live workout with Barbell Bench Press: 3 sets filled and ticked; the save fails (database error)

user_sees: 'Could not save' and 'Something went wrong saving your workout. Your sets are still here — tap Finish to try again.'

start: A gym member in a live workout with Barbell Bench Press: 3 sets filled and ticked

user_sees: Question 'Discard this workout?' with 'Nothing is saved. Your history stays as it was.'

steps.action: Cancel, finish instead; then edit the saved workout and tap 'Discard workout' there
user_sees: 'Discard changes?' with 'Your edits will be thrown away. The saved workout stays as it was.'
must_not: The saved workout deleted when only the edits were discarded

start: A gym member not signed in to a MettleUp account, after saving a workout

steps.action: Save a workout and look at Settings > Your data
user_sees: The workout is saved on this phone only
must_not: The workout sent to the gym or a server without the member signing in
